scope: GT-BE19000AI BCM Ubuntu migration; separate AI-board OS remains unchanged
user_requirement: ASUS functionality must be validated before flashing the Ubuntu migration. Debian packaging is authorized but does not establish runtime compatibility.

offline_prerequisites.requirement: Collision-free dpkg ownership, actual apt install/remove/reinstall, unchanged Ubuntu base files, correct per-ABI runtime and protected updates.

Actual target-runtime loader and relocation checks for rc, HTTPD, AiMesh, radios, RGB, AI control, native helpers and required plugins; all GLIBC_PRIVATE dependencies resolved with preserved vendor ABI.
Board-specific rebuilt rc works below systemd PID1, uses authenticated manager notification, retains ordinary signals, and never accidentally signals PID1 or starts duplicate daemons.
ASUS startup/shutdown and config changes preserve Ubuntu fstab, hosts policy, machine-id, apt/dpkg state and persistent /var; ownership of generated ASUS configs is explicit.
ASUS script and system()/popen() semantics are validated; private legacy shell use is explicit and Ubuntu /bin/sh is preserved.
Actual ASUS service orchestration boots, stops, restarts and recovers under the exact Ubuntu/kernel candidate in isolated testing; mocks alone do not satisfy this gate.
Shared-memory/message layouts match actual producers and consumers. New time64 code preserves tested legacy blob boundaries; no blanket ARM32 time32 workaround.
Final eMMC layout, UUID boot selection, fallback and firmware updater behavior are validated; installing a .deb cannot flash or commit a slot.

functional_profile: all configured radios, SSIDs, authentication and client association
wired AiMesh membership, management and backhaul
local authenticated web management, settings, language and existing UI fixes
AI-board link and management without unintended AI-board restart
RGB changes and retained RGB fix
USB detection/mount and enabled USB applications
telemetry, client tables, CCR overview and integrated collectors
targeted service restarts and orderly system shutdown

physical_acceptance.limitation: QEMU cannot establish physical Broadcom radio/Runner or CAN/USB behavior. A recoverable board trial and its limitations must be explicitly recorded after offline prerequisites; permanent boot acceptance additionally requires this functional profile to pass on the exact board candidate.

forbidden_shortcuts: Treating a staged payload .deb, loader trace, mock broker or Ubuntu-only boot as proof ASUS works
Replacing native Ubuntu libc, shell, init or package-owned files by force-overwrite
Running ASUS hardware initialization or firmware upgrade from package maintainer scripts
Copying a BE98 runtime binary without checking this board's ABI and required behavior
